numberToWords
skills.card:
numberToWords — Spell a number out in English words, the way it is said aloud or written on a cheque.
  needs: value: number
  optional: style: string, currency: string
  e.g. "write 1234 in words" → {"value":1234}

value.label: number
value.prompt: Which number should I write out?

examples: write 105.50 as words for a cheque

skills.name: amortizeLoan

annualRate.label: annual rate %
annualRate.prompt: What is the annual interest rate, as a percentage?

examples: monthly payment on a 200000 mortgage at 5 percent over 30 years
repayments on a 15000 car loan at 7.5% over 5 years
interest free loan of 1200 over 12 months
monthly cost of borrowing 5000 at 10% for 24 months

skills.name: applyDiscount
skills.card:
applyDiscount — Take a single percentage or amount off one price and show what you save.
  needs: price: number
  optional: percent: number, amount: number
  e.g. "25% off a 80 jacket" → {"price":80,"percent":25}

skills.name: applyTax
skills.card:
applyTax — Add tax to a price, or work backwards from a price that already includes it, at a rate you supply.
  needs: amount: number, rate: number
  optional: amountIncludesTax: boolean
  e.g. "add 20% vat to 250" → {"amount":250,"rate":20}

rate.label: tax rate %
rate.prompt: What tax rate, as a percentage?

amountIncludesTax.label: already includes tax
amountIncludesTax.description: the amount given is the gross, work backwards

examples: what is the vat included in 300 at 20%
how much of my 1200 invoice is 5% tax

skills.name: compoundInterest
skills.card:
compoundInterest — Grow a sum year on year, with each year’s interest earning interest too.
  needs: principal: number, rate: number, years: number
  optional: frequency: string, contribution: number
  e.g. "what does 1000 grow to at 5% for 10 years" → {"principal":1000,"rate":5,"years":10}

principal.label: starting amount
principal.prompt: How much is the starting amount?

rate.label: annual rate %
rate.prompt: What annual interest rate, as a percentage?

examples: what does 1000 grow to at 5% for 10 years
save 200 a month at 6% for 20 years

skills.name: convertCurrencyFixed

from.label: from currency
from.prompt: Which currency is it in? (a three-letter code)

to.label: to currency
to.prompt: Which currency should I convert to?

rate.label: rate per 1 unit
rate.prompt: What exchange rate should I use? (how many of the target currency per 1 of the source)

examples: 50 gbp in euros at a rate of 1.18
how much is 250 dollars in yen at 150.53

skills.name: hourlyToSalary
skills.card:
hourlyToSalary — Turn an hourly wage into the yearly salary it adds up to.
  needs: hourly: number
  optional: hoursPerWeek: number, weeksPerYear: number
  e.g. "what is 25 an hour as a salary" → {"hourly":25}
examples: what is 25 an hour as a salary
annual salary for 18.50 an hour at 40 hours
salary for 60 an hour at 20 hours a week
what does 12.21 an hour come to a year

skills.name: markupMargin
skills.card:
markupMargin — Convert between markup and margin, and work out a selling price from a cost.
  needs: cost: number
  optional: markup: number, margin: number, price: number
  e.g. "sell at 50% markup on a cost of 20" → {"cost":20,"markup":50}

margin.label: margin %
margin.description: percentage of the selling price that is profit

price.label: selling price
price.description: the selling price, if you already know it

examples: sell at 50% markup on a cost of 20
what price gives a 40% margin on cost 60
my cost is 12 and I sell at 20 — what is the margin
price for a 25% margin on 75 cost

skills.name: salaryToHourly
skills.card:
salaryToHourly — Divide an annual salary down to what a single hour is worth.
  needs: annual: number
  optional: hoursPerWeek: number, weeksPerYear: number
  e.g. "what is 48750 a year per hour" → {"annual":48750}
examples: what is 48750 a year per hour
hourly rate for a 60000 salary at 40 hours
35000 a year as an hourly rate
what does 26000 work out to hourly at 30 hours

skills.name: savingsGoal
skills.card:
savingsGoal — Work out how long a savings goal takes, or how much to put aside each month.
  needs: target: number, annualRate: number
  optional: monthly: number, months: integer
  e.g. "how long to save 10000 at 250 a month with no interest" → {"target":10000,"monthly":250,"annualRate":0}

target.label: savings goal
target.prompt: How much do you want to save?

annualRate.label: annual rate %
annualRate.prompt: What annual interest rate does the account pay? Use 0 if it pays none.

monthly.label: monthly deposit
monthly.description: how much goes in each month

examples: how long to save 10000 at 250 a month with no interest
how many months to save 10000 at 250 a month at 3 percent
saving 100 a month at 2 percent for a 5000 goal
how much a month to save 10000 in 24 months at 3 percent
what monthly amount saves 6000 in 3 years at 2.5 percent

skills.name: simpleInterest

rate.label: annual rate %
rate.prompt: What annual interest rate, as a percentage?

examples: simple interest on 1000 at 5% for 3 years
how much interest on 2500 at 4.5% over 2 years
interest on 500 at 10% for half a year
non-compounding interest on 500 at 4% for 2 years
flat interest on 1200 at 6 percent over 18 months

skills.name: bmiCalculate

weightKg.label: weight (kg)
weightKg.prompt: What is the weight in kilograms?

heightCm.label: height (cm)
heightCm.prompt: What is the height in centimetres?

skills.name: heartRateZones
skills.card:
heartRateZones — Split a maximum heart rate you supply into the standard five training zones.
  needs: maxHeartRate: integer
  optional: restingHeartRate: integer
  e.g. "heart rate zones for a max of 190" → {"maxHeartRate":190}

maxHeartRate.label: max heart rate (bpm)
maxHeartRate.prompt: What is the maximum heart rate, in beats per minute? (a measured figure — I will not estimate one from age)

restingHeartRate.label: resting heart rate (bpm)
restingHeartRate.description: if given, zones are worked out by heart rate reserve instead

examples: heart rate zones for a max of 190
training zones from a measured max of 180
zones using heart rate reserve with resting 50

skills.name: paceCalculate
skills.card:
paceCalculate — Convert between running pace, speed and finish time over a distance.
  needs: distanceKm: number
  optional: paceSecondsPerKm: number, timeSeconds: number
  e.g. "finish time for a 10k at 5:30 per km" → {"distanceKm":10,"paceSecondsPerKm":330}
examples: finish time for a 10k at 5:30 per km
what pace is a 3 hour marathon
half marathon at 6 minutes per km
finish time for a parkrun at 4:45 per km

skills.name: sleepCycleTimes
skills.card:
sleepCycleTimes — Work out wake or bedtimes a whole number of sleep cycles apart.
  needs: time: string
  optional: direction: string, cycleMinutes: integer, fallAsleepMinutes: integer
  e.g. "when should I go to bed to wake at 7am" → {"time":"07:00"}

direction.label: time given is
direction.description: wake = the time given is when you want to get up

examples: when should I go to bed to wake at 7am
if I go to sleep now at 23:00 when should I wake
wake times with a 100 minute cycle
bedtimes for a 08:00 alarm with no wind-down

skills.name: splitTimes
skills.card:
splitTimes — Work out the pace and split times needed to finish a distance in a target time.
  needs: distance: number, time: string
  optional: unit: string
  e.g. "split times for a 10k in 50 minutes" → {"distance":10,"time":"50:00"}

time.label: target time
time.prompt: What is the target time? Write it as 50:00 or 1:45:00.

examples: split times for a 10k in 50 minutes
what pace do I need for a 5k in 22:30
